name: zinterp_context_open_prepared_script_stream
description: zInterp_Context::OpenPreparedScriptStream finds a prepared-script entry by case-insensitive path, rejects prepared input when the local source is newer, seeks the prepared stream to the entry payload offset, and returns the shared stream.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c5740 validates the null prepared stream guard, entry-count pointer at context offset 0x8c, prepared-entry table at 0x90, _stricmp path search over 0x80-byte entries, local source _stat/difftime check against entry fileTime, fseek to fileOffset, and FILE* return on success.
The native smokes verify case-insensitive matching, missing entry rejection, seek/return behavior for a prepared payload offset, and newer local source rejection without advancing the stream.
